description: This PHP source file defines the DocumentPopupPicker class, which extends the Popup_Picker class. It is used for filtering documents in the compose email popup by generating a WHERE clause based on request parameters. It also includes licensing and contact information related to SugarCRM and SuiteCRM.

classes.name: DocumentPopupPicker
classes.description: A class used to filter documents in the compose email popup by generating a WHERE clause based on request parameters.

methods.name: _get_where_clause
methods.description: Returns a WHERE clause string used to filter documents in the popup, based on request parameters.
